assertions: The pinned production maintainer serially reconciles recent persisted Sessions from each stored cursor and excludes the current Session.
Two persisted Sessions with unconsumed semantic events update the real current.md and their individual cursors in an isolated production Personal Knowledge Base.
An exact replay makes no model call and reports no observed Session increments.
If a later Session fails after an earlier Session commits, a subsequent run skips the committed cursor and resumes the remaining Session.
Session history and confirmed durable Markdown remain unchanged; generated durable candidates stay unconfirmed proposals.
The public result contains opaque Session references but no raw text, cwd, cursor values, model route or private repository path.
Coverage explicitly states recentSessionLimit=12, incomplete enumeration, source failures not fully observable, fullProjectionRebuild=false and cursorReset=false.
